code:
import FoundationModels

struct AIProfile: Codable {
    var experienceLevel: String
    var preferredLanguage: String
    var conciseAnswers: Bool
}

func personalizedPrompt(question: String, profile: AIProfile) -> String {
    """
    Erfahrungsniveau: \(profile.experienceLevel)
    Sprache: \(profile.preferredLanguage)
    Antwortstil: \(profile.conciseAnswers ? "kurz" : "ausführlich")
    Frage: \(question)
    """
}
